brand.tagline: Who guards the guardian? Your rules do.

welcome.title: Invest together. Let an AI do the work. Keep it inside your rules.
welcome.lead: Plenum lets a group pool money and hand day-to-day management to an AI manager. The group writes the rules, an independent administrator prices the fund, and only people a member invites can join. Investing on your own works too, with the same protections.

points.rules: Rules the AI can't break. Every trade is checked against your group's rules before it happens.
points.price: An independent price. A separate administrator values the fund. The AI never does.
points.people: Invite only. Only someone holding an invite signed by a member can join, checked onchain.
points.fire: You stay in charge. Bigger moves need your approval, and members can pause the manager at any time.

landing.heroLead: Pool money with people you trust, or invest on your own. An AI manages it daily, and contracts on Monad keep it inside your rules.
landing.manifesto: Professional money management starts around $25 million. Everyone else runs on a spreadsheet and trust in one treasurer.
landing.manifestoB: AI can now do that job for almost nothing. But no group should have to trust an AI with its money. With Plenum, it doesn't have to.
landing.dutiesLead: No part of Plenum both manages and prices, or manages and decides who gets in. Each duty is checked by a contract the others can't skip.
landing.tryLead: Pick a move for a real group's AI manager on Monad testnet. Its contract answers: allowed, refused, or sent to the members for a vote.
landing.evidenceTitle: Even with the key, it can't take the money.
landing.evidenceLead: The worst a fully compromised manager can do is move money between assets the group already approved, within its limits. Members change the rules, the manager and their own stake on their terms. These are the real transactions.
landing.flowTitle: From a group chat to a governed fund that can change with you.
landing.closeTitle: Your group. Your rules. An AI that answers to both.
landing.disclaimer: Plenum is software, not a fund or an adviser. It runs on Monad testnet with test money. Simulated assets and test dollars are labelled MOCK; the backup price writer is labelled FALLBACK.
